node.title: Primitive exact-list star coverage by the u1 record ledger
node.statement: At every x4 official row and every transported quotient row, fix the declared support-wise priority map and a primitive residual locator-prefix fiber. For each base support S0, inject every other residual support S, through its canonical order-t star-PTE record (S\S0,S0\S), into exactly one record counted by the u1_x4_direct_column_budget ledger, with multiplicity at most one and with the same quotient/dihedral/moment/U2/DLI strips. In particular justify the load-bearing F-4 passage from general order-t star records to the order-(h-1) minimal records used by the current h>=4 route, or re-pose u1 to count all required records and re-prove its budget. This coverage gives |F_z^prim|-1<=R_post and is required uniformly before the u1 bound can be consumed as a worst-word list bound.
node.falsifier: A correctly stripped primitive same-prefix pair whose canonical star-PTE record is not assigned to any u1 record, is assigned only after changing strip ownership, or incurs unbounded multiplicity under the proposed coverage map.
